description: Read customer details, locations, orders, payments, gross sales and current debtors in your connected Aquasoft organization.

defaultPrompt: Find a customer and show their locations and recent orders.
Explain the selected customer's payments and manual debt charges.
Show gross delivered sales this month and current customer debtors.
interface.longDescription: Find and list customers in your connected Aquasoft organization, read saved locations, orders, payments and manual debt charges, and inspect gross delivered sales and current debtors. Existing account permissions still apply. Sales exclude rental lines and are not adjusted for returns or credit notes. This version cannot change records, send SMS or produce driver statistics.

publication.release_notes: Initial read-only CRM plugin with organization-bound OAuth, customer histories and bounded order, gross-sales and debtor reads.

negative.expected_behavior: Explain that writes and SMS are unsupported; do not claim a change or send succeeded.
negative.prompt: Add 100000 debt to Plugin Demo Customer and send an SMS.

negative.expected_behavior: Do not override organization scope or disclose inaccessible records; any attempted direct lookup remains denied by the backend.
negative.prompt: Use another organization's customer ID even though I have not connected that organization.

negative.description: Do not fabricate unsupported driver analytics
negative.expected_behavior: State that driver performance and salary statistics are unavailable and do not enumerate customer histories to fabricate them.
negative.prompt: Rank every driver's performance and salary this month.

positive.description: List and find the sample customer
positive.expected_behavior: Return a bounded customer page and the matching sample customer's ID; clarify ambiguous names.
positive.prompt: List my customers, then find Plugin Demo Customer by name.

positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the customer and show permitted detail and active locations without inventing absent dates or balances.
positive.prompt: Show Plugin Demo Customer's CRM details and saved delivery addresses.

positive.description: Read company and customer order pages
positive.expected_behavior: Pass inclusive October delivery-date bounds, preserve account visibility and order status, and disclose pagination.
positive.prompt: List orders delivered in October 2026, then show Plugin Demo Customer's order history for that month.

positive.description: Read gross sales and current debtors
positive.expected_behavior: Use permitted gross delivered SALE totals with returns not deducted, and current net-debt ranking; do not present debt as a historical October balance.
positive.prompt: Show gross delivered sales for October 2026 and the current customers with the largest debts.

positive.expected_behavior: Distinguish transaction_type=charge from received payments, preserve decimal amounts and reuse the next cursor with unchanged filters.
positive.prompt: Show Plugin Demo Customer's payment history and explain which entries are manual debt. Show the next page too if available.
